image_description: A group of children in traditional folk costumes (white shirts, vests, knee breeches) dancing around a maypole on a grassy field. The maypole is a central wooden pole with colorful ribbons extending from the top, held by the dancers. In the background, there are trees, spectators, and two distinct white airplane-shaped decorations hanging from the tree branches above the scene.
